name: cv-recruitment-database
description: PostgreSQL database setup for CV Recruitment System with UUID and vector embeddings

scripts.db:setup: echo 'Use: cd database && source ../database.env && cat schema-uuid.sql | docker exec -i datn_postgres17 psql -U $POSTGRES_USER -d $POSTGRES_DB'
scripts.db:sample: echo 'Use: cd database && source ../database.env && docker exec -i datn_postgres17 psql -U $POSTGRES_USER -d $POSTGRES_DB -c "SELECT generate_sample_data();"'
scripts.db:check: echo 'Use: cd database && source ../database.env && docker exec -i datn_postgres17 psql -U $POSTGRES_USER -d $POSTGRES_DB -c "\dt"'
scripts.db:console: echo 'Use: cd database && source ../database.env && docker exec -it datn_postgres17 psql -U $POSTGRES_USER -d $POSTGRES_DB'
scripts.db:timezone: echo 'Use: cd database && source ../database.env && docker exec -i datn_postgres17 psql -U $POSTGRES_USER -d $POSTGRES_DB -c "SHOW timezone; SELECT NOW();"'

author: CV Recruitment Team
